otherwise.does: A decision-table value is judged next: whether it is a number, and whether it appears in the adapter as a number. None of its sites has been given yet.

The value's sites are over. If it had a site, a value is located in production code (for the rest of the judgement), and if none of its sites was killed, it survived. If it had no site, and it is a number that appears in the adapter, it is in the adapter.

emits.onlyWhen: The value had a site, and none of its sites was killed
The value had no site, and it is a number that appears in the adapter

otherwise.does: The judgement is over. If no value was located in production code, no mutant was killed, and the production code is not shared with other components in a way that could not be narrowed (shared), the mutation is ineffective.

emits.onlyWhen: No value was located in production code, no mutant was killed, and the production code is not shared with other components in a way that could not be narrowed

otherwise.does: A mutant (every one, the sites of values included) and whether it was killed.

behaviors.description: A site of the value: a place in production code where the value was changed, and whether that made the tests fail (killed).
behaviors.name: Site

descriptions.component: Decides whether a mutation report passes the mutation gate, value by value and as a whole.
descriptions.data.anyKilled: Whether some mutant so far was killed.
descriptions.data.located: Whether some value so far had a site.
descriptions.data.sawSite: Whether the value being judged has a site (a place in production code where it was broken).
descriptions.data.siteKilled: Whether some site of the value being judged was killed (breaking it made the tests fail).
descriptions.data.valueInAdapter: Whether the value being judged is a number that appears in the adapter.
descriptions.effects.InAdapter: The value being judged has no site in production code, but appears in the adapter: the decision was put in the adapter.
descriptions.effects.Ineffective: No decision-table value was found in production code, and no mutant at all was killed: the tested behaviour does not come from production code.
descriptions.effects.Survived: The value being judged has sites, and none was killed: it is not decided by production code.
descriptions.states.IN_VALUE: The sites of one value are being given.
descriptions.states.VALUES: Values are being judged, one after another.

anyKilledNow.description: Whether some mutant so far, the one given included, was killed

locatedNow.description: Whether some value so far, the one whose sites are over included, had a site

valueInAdapterNow.description: Whether the value given is a number and appears in the adapter
